english.title: Sell controlled alcoholic products wholesale without approval of commissioners

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Alcohol; Alcohol duty; Approvals; Conditions; Controlled activities; HMRC Commissioners; Regulations; Restrictions; Wholesale trade

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who was UK-established for the purposes of value added tax, carried on a controlled activity by selling controlled alcoholic products wholesale, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF ALCOHOLIC PRODUCTS..), otherwise than in accordance with an approval given by the Commissioners under section 100 of the Finance Act (No. 2) Act 2023 when you knew or had reasonable grounds to suspect that the buyer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), was carrying on a trade or business, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRADE OR BUSINESS..), and that the alcoholic products were for sale or supply in the course of that trade or business
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 100(1) and 104(1) and (5) of the Finance (No. 2) Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
